claims.claim: Quintus Septimius Florens Tertullianus was a Carthaginian Christian writer born around 155–160 AD and died after 220 AD.
Tertullian wrote the epistle Ad martyras (To the Martyrs) probably in 197 AD, at the very beginning of the Roman persecution, before any Christians had yet been martyred.
Some scholars date the work to the persecution of 202–203 AD, when the martyrs Perpetua and Felicitas were executed.
The letter is addressed to Christians who were imprisoned and awaiting execution, offering them encouragement and spiritual exhortation.
